developer_context.problem_scenario: A web server parses incoming URL query strings into nested JavaScript objects.
developer_context.observable_behavior: Excessively deep bracket nesting in incoming query parameters causes exponential recursion, resulting in server denial of service.
developer_context.expected_outcome: Enforce strict recursion depth limits when parsing structured URL query parameters to reject malicious payloads.
developer_context.environmental_context: URL query parameter parsing during request preprocessing.
